rules.title: Not Compile Ready
rules.description: Record fails structural checks required for COMPILE_RECORDS.
rules.detection_rule: FAIL if any ERROR from record/ontology/relationship validators present.

rules.title: Not Graph Ready
rules.description: Graph projection would violate ontology/graph constraints.
rules.detection_rule: FAIL if cycles, duplicate edges, or invalid node types remain.

rules.title: Not Search Ready
rules.description: canonical_key / aliases / keywords missing for search indexes.
rules.detection_rule: WARN if canonical_index/alias/keyword entries absent for draft+ records.
rules.recommended_resolution: Provide index hints; sync at PB-03.

rules.title: Not Documentation Ready
rules.description: Required doc fields (definition, scope, examples policy) incomplete for docs generator.

rules.title: Not Release Ready
rules.detection_rule: FAIL if approval≠approved or freeze≠frozen or ERROR/CRITICAL remain.

rules.title: Build Manifest Inputs Unresolved
rules.description: build_manifest input refs cannot be discovered.

rules.title: Canon Manifest Incomplete
rules.detection_rule: FAIL if any required discovery array absent.

rules.title: Artifact Manifest Gap
rules.description: Authored KR markdown not listed in artifact_manifest when compile expects it.
rules.detection_rule: WARN if authored path not in artifacts[].

rules.title: Schema Contract Drift
rules.description: Record shape incompatible with standards knowledge_record.schema.json.
rules.detection_rule: FAIL JSON Schema validation against KR master schema.

rules.title: Search Index Alias Drift
rules.description: Alias index canonical_name disagrees with record identity.

rules.title: Documentation Generator Missing Topic
rules.description: Record not attached to any topic_index entry for docs browse.
rules.detection_rule: INFO if no TOPIC-* includes record_id.
